Three.js r180 and OrbitControls were reused from the user's existing legoskill project:
`brick-scene/assets/viewer/vendor/`.

GLTFLoader and BufferGeometryUtils are the matching r180 files from the official repository:

- https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/r180/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js
